sloka: ततःकमलपत्राक्षः श्यामो निरुपमो महान् ।उवाच रामस्तम् सूतं पितुराख्याहि मामिति ॥२-३४-१॥
transliteration: tataḥkamalapatrākṣaḥ śyāmo nirupamo mahān ।uvāca rāmastam sūtaṁ piturākhyāhi māmiti ॥2-34-1॥

translations.english: Let my father be informed of my arrival, said the lotuseyed, darkcomplexioned, venerable, peerless Rama to the charioteer.
